text:
Asha - Finance: Heads up — AWS marketplace statement for Feb shows a ~42,135.67 USD shortfall on reseller payouts vs our ledger. Not a tiny rounding thing. Can we triage?
Ben - Infra: On it. Do we have the invoice lines? might be a commit vs marketplace-credit mapping issue.
Miguel - FinOps: I pulled the raw CSV from the marketplace portal and our accounting export. Uploading a quick diff in the sheet: https://redwood.company/sheets/marketplace-feb (internal).
Priya - Legal: If this is a reseller passthrough issue, check the contract clause about fee passthrough and timing. Some resellers net out AWS fees differently.
Jules - Eng: Quick note — infra telemetry shows a chunk of Dedicated fleet in us-west-1 serving requests that the marketplace records under us-west-2 for a subset of SKUs. Could be a region-tagging mismatch on our side.
Asha - Finance: Region mismatch would explain routed billing differences. Miguel, can you confirm which invoice lines correspond to the reserved capacity commits vs on-demand marketplace purchases?
Miguel - FinOps: Yep. Sample from AWS export that looks suspicious:
```
InvoiceID,ProductCode,UsageType,Region,Amount
inv-202402,redwood-dedicated,ReservedInstance,us-west-2, -42135.67
inv-202402,redwood-dedicated,OnDemand,us-west-1, 0.00
```
That negative line is a credit applied in us-west-2 but our ledger shows commit in us-west-1.
Ben - Infra: We recently changed the routing prefix for Dedicated nodes to a regional alias — logs may still be tagging instances with the old region. Will check cluster metadata sync.
Jules - Eng: I already found a small bug in the node registrar (aws-region override dropped for some hosts). patch ready: `region-fix-2024-02` — want me to deploy a hotfix to reconcile tags?
Priya - Legal: If we fix tagging, we should also document the reconciliation steps in case the reseller disputes timing. Keep a changelog entry.
Asha - Finance: Action items: 1) Miguel to extract invoice lines per region and map to ledger (ETA 2h). 2) Ben + Jules to verify node region tags and run a backfill (ETA EOD). 3) Priya to draft short note for reseller team if we confirm they billed to us-west-2.
marketplace-bot: Automated report attached: marketplace-feb-2024-summary.csv (uploaded).
Miguel - FinOps: On the ledger side I see two adjustments already applied 2024-02-05, but values don't match the marketplace CSV. I'm going to run a row-level join and flag mismatches.
Ben - Infra: Backfill approach: run a reconciliation job that copies `instance_metadata.region` -> `billing_region` for the affected hosts, then re-run cost attribution. Will coordinate with FinOps to not double-count.
Asha - Finance: Thanks — keep this thread for updates. If anyone finds the root cause is reseller-side (they routed credits to a different marketplace account), we'll loop in partnerships. :thumbsup:
Jules - Eng: Quick debug note: command to list problematic nodes:
```
kubectl get nodes -l role=dedicated -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.metadata.labels.aws-region}\n'
```
Will run and post results.
Miguel - FinOps: Preliminary join done — 428 distinct lines mismatch, total ~42,135.67. Sending CSV to Asha.
Asha - Finance: Received. Setting up a reconciliation ticket and tagging this thread. If we need to escalate to reseller ops, I'll open a vendor SR.
marketplace-bot: Incident tag applied: marketplace-billing-discrepancy-1795223345
Asha - Finance: ETA update — Miguel estimates we can produce a reconciled report by 17:00 PT. Ben/Jules aim to have backfill plan ready by then too.
Jules - Eng: Deployed `region-fix-2024-02` to staging, no regressions. Will schedule canary to prod after noon.
Priya - Legal: If we end up asking reseller to reissue credits, need to include invoice excerpts + node lists. Keep exports ready.
Asha - Finance: Great. We'll sync when the reconciled report lands. Thanks team.
